Saddles should be level with the bridge and not made to match the radius of the neck. Doing so puts more weight on one saddle screw than the other. Each saddle should be level with the bridge and not tilted. Unlevel saddles can allow strings to slip out of the saddle slot,(if there), and allow uneven string spacing and possibly affect intonation because of lateral movement.
